name: IntentShare
subtitle: Seriousness before exposure
summary: A privacy-first evaluation and discovery platform designed to connect ideas, teams, talent, and opportunities through an Intent Score.
overview: IntentShare proposes a shared credibility score for ideas, founders, student clubs, and talent. Its central principle is to assess seriousness and readiness before revealing an idea or identity to sponsors, institutions, or investors.
current_state: A website was built using Emergent at intentshar.com. Further work is paused because of Emergent credit limits, as reported by the owner. The supplied documents describe a broader product vision; they do not establish which planned features were implemented. Current website availability has not been verified.
highlights: Private idea submission and discovery based on project stage, sector, and readiness.
A proposed Intent Score combining AI-assisted analysis and human evaluation.
Planned workflows for clubs and competitions, company challenges, incubators, and collaboration.
next_focus: Recover the existing website source and deployment configuration, document implemented features, and choose a sustainable path to resume development.
